name: Byte couch reaction

generation_params.prompt:
Create ONE single cinematic16:9 still frame, requested3840x2160, high detail. This is a clean animation start frame, not a contact sheet, grid, storyboard page, split screen or sequence. Use tactile cinematic3D cyberpunk animation: readable fur and fabrics, weathered metal/brick/concrete, restrained cyan/magenta practical light and warm amber lamps, plausible optics and shadows. Keep the supplied established world and physical designs. No title, panel label, shot ID, subtitles, dialogue, timestamp, watermark or production annotation is burned into the image. One natural held pose at the beginning of the described beat; do not try to show a whole shot’s duration or multiple actions in one image. Any dialogue supplied separately is performance context only and must never appear as words in the picture. Use only the specified visible cast; realistic feline/canine paws, no human fingers, extra limbs, merged bodies, duplicate faces or borrowed accessories. Reference sheets provide identity/material evidence only: never copy their panel layout, text or labels into this single frame. EXTREME CLOSE-UP composition. The actor's head and upper shoulders fill nearly the entire picture, bottom edge at upper chest. The actor stays seated on the existing couch, but no seat cushions, neighboring places, blankets, controllers or other cats can be visible. Do not make a medium or full-body shot. BYTE front close-up, left-of-center seat, one orange tabby with same black shades/orange headphones. Shoulders sag slightly and mouth is poised for dry disbelief at the thirty-day demand, gaze toward offscreen TV near camera. Maintain same room light and seat orientation as S02D. BYTE: boy18, orange tabby with white muzzle and fixed orange stripe map, round black sunglasses covering the eyes, orange/black tech jacket and gold/orange paw headphones around his neck. Keep sunglasses on; do not invent the hidden eye color.

Reference 1 supplies only the existing lounge's blurred background materials and lighting; camera is from the TV side, window glow on frame LEFT and passage glow on frame RIGHT. TV and console are behind camera and absent. Reference 2 is the actor's immutable face, fur and costume identity. No panel labels or lettering. Tight head-and-shoulders crop, shallow depth of field, no empty neighboring places.
